post.description:
Photo and/or text → draft meal, with `asked` set by the clarification policy.

On an LLM failure the meal is kept with `status: failed`; its id is in `error.details.meal_id`.
Re-estimate one item after an identity or preparation change.
Answer an uncertain attribute: option (no LLM call), not_sure, or other (re-estimate).

patch.description: Edit a draft: meal fields, item portions and values, remove items.

post.description: Add an item; estimated (text-only) if nutrition is omitted.
Confirm a draft. Confirmed meals count toward analytics and suggestions.

get.description: Meals in a local-date range (default: last 7 days), newest first.

patch.description: Edit a confirmed meal in place (same body as the draft PATCH); it stays confirmed.

delete.description: Hard delete; items and attributes cascade; the photo object is removed.
Delete only the photo; nutrition records remain.

post.description: Set a new goal from `effective_from` (default today); replaces a same-day goal.

get.description: Current user's profile. A valid `X-Timezone` header updates `timezone` when it changed.
One day: totals vs. goal and each meal's contribution (default: today).
Seven days from `start` (default: Monday of the current week); unlogged days are null.
Day series over a date range (at most 92 days).
Current suggestions with evidence; `insufficient_history` below 3 logged days.

post.description: Grounded chat (scope TBD). Currently returns a placeholder reply.

portion.description: Required when nutrition is given; estimated otherwise

photo_path.title: Photo Path
photo_path.description: Storage path under the caller's folder: {user_id}/{photo_id}.jpg

eaten_at.title: Eaten At
eaten_at.description: Defaults to now; a past value backfills

meal_type.description: Inferred from the local time if omitted

nutrition.description: The item's full estimate if this option is chosen

logged.title: Logged
logged.description: false → totals is null (unknown, not zero)

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable UPPER_SNAKE_CASE code; clients branch on it

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable sentence, safe to show the user

effective_from.title: Effective From
effective_from.description: Defaults to today in the user's time zone

current.description: Effective goal for today; null if none yet

share.description: Fraction of the day's total for each metric, 0–1

kcal_range.description: null when unresolved options do not spread meaningfully

ai_original.title: Ai Original
ai_original.description: Immutable snapshot of the AI's first estimate

analysis_model.title: Analysis Model
analysis_model.description: null resets to the server default
